newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P affirms ratings of 5 Japan non-life insurers.
newsitem.headline: S&P affirms ratings of 5 Japan non-life insurers.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp said on Wednesday that it had affirmed its ratings for five Japanese non-life insurance companies.
S&P affirmed the claims-paying ability ratings and senior debt ratings of Chiyoda Fire & Marine Insurance Co Ltd and Dai-Tokyo Fire & Marine Insurance Co Ltd.
S&P also affirmed the claims-paying ability ratings of Nichido Fire & Marine Insurance Co Ltd, Tokio Marine & Fire Insurance Co Ltd and Yasuda Fire & Marine Insurance Co Ltd.

S&P said in a statement that the industry was financially strong overall, with high asset quality, sound capitalisation and catastrophe reserves largely restored after supporting climatic losses in 1991.
The claims-paying ability ratings and senior debt ratings of Chiyoda and Dai-Tokyo were affirmed as AA+, S&P said.
Their outlooks were affirmed as stable, it said.
Nichido's claims-paying ability rating was affirmed as AA+ and the claims-paying ability ratings of both Tokio and Yasuda were affirmed as AAA, S&P said.
